title: MRI Parameter Simulator Pro (whole-body edition)
description:
An educational MRI simulator distributed as a single HTML file that runs offline in a web browser. Changing the acquisition parameters of 60 sequences on 12 analytic virtual phantoms updates the simulated image, scan time, SNR, SAR, tissue-contrast curves and k-space filling in real time; tissue signals can optionally be computed with extended phase graphs (EPG) or a Bloch-equivalent per-pixel mode. It also maps sequence and option names across six scanner vendors with confidence flags, offers a learning mode, and is available in Japanese, English and Simplified Chinese.

It is an educational approximation, not a medical device, and is not intended for clinical use. It is not an official tool of any scanner vendor.
